title.en: صار — the verb that does seven jobs

objective: One verb, seven distinct meanings, all of them common: it happened, it became, it’s been X years, he started to, he already has, now there is, and "that’s not on". Learning صار properly is one of the biggest single jumps in sounding fluent.

grammar.body: The book lays them out one at a time with examples. Read each meaning, then say the examples out loud until the pattern of each one is in your ear — they are distinguished by what follows صار, not by the verb itself.

chunks.ar: هي صارَت إسرائيليّة. مِش مْبَيِّن عَليها أنّه اتْوَلَدَت في أمريكا.
chunks.en: She became Israeli — you’d never guess she was born in America.

chunks.ar: حَبيبي صايِر رومانسي. بِجيب لي شوكولاطة وزْهور.
chunks.en: My love has turned romantic. He brings me chocolate and flowers.

chunks.ar: صار لي خَمْسِ سْنين ساكِن في الْقُدْس.
chunks.en: I’ve been living in Jerusalem for five years.

chunks.ar: – شُفِت مْحَمَّد؟ – صار مْسافِر مِن أُسْبُوع.
chunks.en: — Have you seen Mohammed? — He’s already been travelling for a week.
chunks.group: meaning 5: Already (صار + verb in the present or AP)
chunks.note: English added by this app — the book prints these untranslated

chunks.ar: بِنْتي بَدَت تِتْعَلَّم قَبِل شَهْرِين وصارَت تُكْتُب وتِقْرا.
chunks.en: My daughter started learning two months ago and she can already write and read.
chunks.group: meaning 5: Already (صار + verb in the present or AP)
chunks.note: English added by this app — the book prints these untranslated

chunks.ar: أمير جاب–لَك الْمَصاري؟ أيْوة، صار حاطِط نُصّ الْمَبْلَغ.
chunks.en: — Did Amir bring you the money? — Yes, he’s already put down half the amount.
chunks.group: meaning 5: Already (صار + verb in the present or AP)
chunks.note: English added by this app — the book prints these untranslated

chunks.ar: إمبارِح ما كان بَنْدُورة في السُّوق والْيُوم صار فيه.
chunks.en: Yesterday there were no tomatoes in the market, and today there are.
chunks.group: meaning 6: To have something after aperod of time it was absent
chunks.note: English added by this app — the book prints these untranslated

chunks.ar: مَحْمود كان فَقير وهَسّا صار عِنْدُه بيت وكُلّ إشي.
chunks.en: Mahmoud used to be poor, and now he has a house and everything.
chunks.group: meaning 6: To have something after aperod of time it was absent
chunks.note: English added by this app — the book prints these untranslated

chunks.ar: كُلّ الصُّبِح ما كان كَهْرِباء (electricity). وفَجْأة صار فيه. مين صَلَّح الْكَهْرَباء؟
chunks.en: There was no electricity all morning. Suddenly there was. Who fixed it?
chunks.group: meaning 6: To have something after aperod of time it was absent
chunks.note: English added by this app — the book prints these untranslated

chunks.en: They haven’t fixed the electricity! That’s not on!
chunks.group: meaning 7: The expression "it can't be" "it's not right": بصيرش
chunks.note: English added by this app — the book prints these untranslated

produce: Make one sentence of your own for each of the seven meanings, out loud. This is hard; do it anyway — it is the whole point of the unit.
